'''Iona Ashmar''' was one of the founders of [[Ghealdan]].

==History==
In the year {{Fy|1109}}, Lady Iona, along with [[Kirin Almeyda]], [[Cynric Talvaen]] and [[Valera Prosnarin]] founded the kingdom of Ghealdan. Lady Iona sat on the [[Crown High Council]].
